# HackifyPro

> HackifyPro is a modern technology and software development company based in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, founded by Nilesh Barela. We build high-speed corporate websites, custom Android applications, SaaS web applications, and complete business management software (Hospital, Restaurant POS, Car Rental, Gym, and Driving School).

HackifyPro transforms business ideas into scalable, secure digital products. We emphasize clean architecture, high Core Web Vitals performance, and direct access to core software engineers.

## Core Services

- [Website Development](https://www.nileshbarela.site/website-development): High-performance, SEO-engineered corporate websites and landing pages built with React, Next.js, and modern CSS.
- [Android App Development](https://www.nileshbarela.site/android-app-development): Native and cross-platform Android mobile applications published to Google Play Store.
- [Web Application Development](https://www.nileshbarela.site/web-application-development): Custom SaaS platforms, cloud dashboards, and business web applications.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.nileshbarela.site/custom-software-development): Bespoke software tailored to proprietary enterprise workflows and database requirements.
- [Business Automation](https://www.nileshbarela.site/business-automation): Workflow automation, WhatsApp Business API integrations, and CRM synchronization.
- [Software Maintenance](https://www.nileshbarela.site/software-maintenance): Proactive updates, security vulnerability patching, and dedicated SLA technical support.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.nileshbarela.site/ui-ux-design): Intuitive user interfaces, responsive design systems, and conversion-focused user journeys.

## Business Software Solutions

- [Hospital Management Software](https://www.nileshbarela.site/hospital-management-software): Complete clinic and hospital operations system covering OPD/IPD, doctor desk, EHR, and pharmacy billing.
- [Car Rental Software](https://www.nileshbarela.site/car-rental-software): Vehicle fleet scheduling, Aadhaar and driving license KYC verification, and digital rental agreements.
- [Restaurant Management POS](https://www.nileshbarela.site/restaurant-management-software): Table management, QR code contactless menus, Kitchen Display System (KDS), and GST billing.
- [Gym Management Software](https://www.nileshbarela.site/gym-management-software): Member registrations, automated fee renewal WhatsApp alerts, biometric attendance, and trainer schedules.
- [Driving School Software](https://www.nileshbarela.site/driving-school-software): Student enrollments, instructor batch management, vehicle maintenance tracking, and RTO test logs.
